settings.text: Woven by hand in Pathamadai, no two quite alike

settings.title: The weave
settings.text:
Korai grass, split by hand, soaked, dyed and woven into paai on the loom in Pathamadai. At its finest the weave is worked wet, thread by thread, until it folds like cloth.

A stripe that wanders or a shade that shifts is the weaver’s hand, and the reason no two pieces are quite alike.

settings.title: Materials & make
settings.text: Korai paai handwoven in Pathamadai, Tamil Nadu. Leather, hand finished. Made in limited number.

settings.title: Care
settings.text: Keep the paai dry and out of long, direct damp. Dust with a soft, dry cloth. Store it filled and upright, the way a mat is kept rolled, never crushed flat under weight.
